correctness.rationale: The metric triangle constraints are valid for 0<r<=1 and N>=3. The dual Lipschitz unit ball equals the range<=1 potential polytope cut by |f1-f2|<=r; its N! order chambers have unimodular gap coordinates and beta(s,N-s) rank-gap CDF. Summation and binomial first moment give vol(P)=2(N-1)r-(N-2)r². Its polar Q is the type A root polytope with opposite distinguished roots stretched by 1/r. Root facets indexed by proper nonempty subsets are products of simplices with unimodular staircase triangulations; Vandermonde yields vol(Q)=B_N(1/r+(N-2)/(N-1)). Opposite visible cap interiors are disjoint, so no mixed term. Product is a strictly concave quadratic, stationary point r*=(N-1)/(2(N-2)) inside (0,1) iff N>=4; for N=3 maximizer is endpoint 1. Independently evaluated exact rational beta-binomial and facet sums for N=3..25 at multiple r, reproducing two volume identities; infinite dimensional N results rely on chamber and facet proof.
